text:
dana-design: dropped a short prototype: https://figma.com/file/abc/compact-rail-v3. Idea: three sticky clusters in left rail, but i floated a new label idea — calling the top cluster "Model Hub" instead of "Models" to hint at discovery + registry. also added inline tiny link icons on rows. want quick sanity check on deeplink semantics + breadcrumbs.
joel-ux: interesting naming experiment. UX Q: If someone lands on a deep link like /workspaces/acme/model-hub/rocket?panel=versions, do we land with the hub expanded and the versions tab visible, or do we present the detail view as the primary canvas and keep the rail visually compact? which feels less surprising for back navigation?
priya-fe: implementation thoughts: we should keep canonical URLs bookmarkable. my preference: canonical nested paths plus ?panel=... query param. on load we'll expand the relevant cluster (no entrance animation), scroll the item into view, then move keyboard focus to the detail panel heading (tabindex=-1 + focus()). For in-app navigations, i'd like to persist list scroll + expanded state. instead of only pushState, consider a tiny session snapshot helper that stores scroll positions keyed by route in sessionStorage so we can handle browser crashes or reloads gracefully: sessionStorage.setItem('navScroll:/workspace/acme/model-hub', JSON.stringify({y: window.scrollY, ts: Date.now()})). on popstate we try state first, then fall back to snapshot.
alina-pm: naming / copy nit: i like "Model Hub" for product marketing but worried about consistency with docs. if we change the nav label we must update docs, onboarding, and API docs. breadcrumbs should show humanized names: "Acme Workspace · Model Hub · rocket" not raw params. permalink badges on rows are great — tooltip should read "Copy model link".
marco-a11y: a11y checklist: 1) cluster headers must be role=button + aria-expanded attribute. 2) when we programmatically expand announce with an aria-live region: suggested phrase: "Model Hub expanded, 7 items". keep it short. 3) after a deep link load, move focus to the detail heading and call focus(), ensure heading has tabindex=-1. 4) permalink icon must be a button with aria-label="Copy link to model" and on copy announce "Link copied to clipboard" via the same aria-live region. 5) ensure keyboard users can reach chevrons and permalinks and the hit target is at least 24x24 and has visible focus styling.
joel-ux: small back-button edgecase: when someone navigates list -> detail (client nav) and then back, the list should restore to previous scroll and expanded state. If we store both history.state and sessionStorage snapshot we should be resilient but test for duplicates. also for direct-deeplink loads, we must not push a fake history entry that breaks expected back behaviour.
priya-fe: agreed. concrete algorithm: on internal navigation to detail do history.pushState({scrollY: window.scrollY, openCluster:'model-hub'}, '', href); also write sessionStorage snapshot keyed by current list route. on popstate, if event.state and event.state.scrollY restore window.scrollTo(0, state.scrollY) and expand cluster per event.state. if no popstate.state but URL indicates nested resource, derive expand state from URL and try sessionStorage lookup for scroll position. tests: unit for push/pop path, e2e for direct load and SPA nav.
alina-pm: copy decisions: let's run a short docs scan before finalizing nav rename. If we keep "Models" everywhere internally, that avoids churn. but i'd like design to prototype "Model Hub" so we can A/B test with a few customers.
linty-bot: route-lint-bot: flagged failing test -> history-restore.spec.js failing for /workspaces/:ws/model-hub sequence. CI #4820.
dana-design: action items from thread: 1) priya to open an implementation PR with history + sessionStorage snapshot + tests. 2) marco to author detailed a11y acceptance strings and aria attributes. 3) design to prepare an A/B Figma where left rail reads "Model Hub" vs "Models" (docs impact note). 4) PM to audit docs for nav label impact. 5) QA to add back-button scroll/restore case. i'll file GH issues and link here. thanks all! :seedling:
